description: Only when the user asks about Edge playlists (formerly collections): follow, unfollow or list ones they follow ("follow playlist federico/comms", a getedge.cc/playlists/ link), or make and edit their own ("make a playlist of the skills I used for X", "add Y to my playlist", "show my playlists", "make it public"). A playlist is a named set of 2 to 20 skills for one job. To create one, pass title, a one-line description and skills as owner/repo@skill exactly as find_skill printed them, in the order to use them; update takes the full new list (add, remove and reorder are one save). New playlists are unlisted (link only). publish makes one public only when all its skills pass Edge's scan, its text has no personal data and 3 signed-in people besides the creator follow it. Never call it on your own initiative. Reply with the returned line.

action.description: follow/unfollow/list followed playlists; create/update/delete/mine/publish/unpublish the user's own

collection_id.description: The playlist's name (federico/comms), id or getedge.cc/playlists/ link; required except for list, mine and create

description.description: create/update: one line on what it is for
